nodes.rationale: U7 decided cut forbids live fetchers/scrapers in research; agents consume caller-supplied evidence with boundary lint, requiring sourced licensed feed plus ToS review for new sources.

nodes.label: Research-Only Simulation-Only Mode
nodes.rationale: Default RESEARCH mode with only sim broker executable prevents real execution; live trading requires explicit approved decision plus separately reviewed safety implementation.

nodes.label: Resource Efficiency and Training Protection
nodes.rationale: Never interrupt active training to free resources; prefer targeted tests and incremental work to respect limited compute and quotas.

nodes.label: Git and Audit Discipline
nodes.rationale: Preserve unrelated changes and audit evidence, forbid destructive git without authorization, and keep claims traceable to file-line evidence distinguishing implementation from verification from inherited claims.

nodes.label: Local-First Single-Machine Constraint
nodes.rationale: Avoid cloud, K8s, NATS and heavy infrastructure in Phase 1 to keep system local, reproducible and low-cost; no new daemons or workflow engines as part of ordinary work.

nodes.label: Knowledge Platform with Evidence and Provenance
nodes.norm_label: knowledge platform with evidence and provenance
nodes.rationale: LLM is not Knowledge: deterministic TypeScript store over table abstraction with SQLite persistence; memory adapter drives vitest.

nodes.label: KnowledgeService facade
nodes.rationale: Agents submit proposals; no direct graph mutation; propose-validate-commit owns all writes with idempotent events.

nodes.label: Conflict detection and resolution
nodes.rationale: Contradictory entity updates never auto-merge; remote deferred as UNRESOLVED; six resolution actions commit new versioned knowledge events.

nodes.label: Memory manager
nodes.rationale: Remember the right things, know staleness and provenance, avoid redoing expensive work; memory is not truth and never skips verification.

nodes.label: Research orchestrator
nodes.rationale: Memory-first selective routing by topic map with per-agent timeout; Knowledge Service alone writes authoritative knowledge.

nodes.label: Strategy intelligence
nodes.rationale: Research is not strategy is not backtest is not validated is not live; backtests are evidence not proof and never auto-activate.

nodes.label: Execution service
nodes.rationale: Only Execution Service to Safety Gate to Broker Adapter to Broker may reach broker; simulator is the only wired adapter; success is safe uncertainty handling.

nodes.label: FACT promotion policy
nodes.rationale: Single LLM or agent claim never becomes FACT; requires 2 independent sources or one authoritative source type; bare LLM FACT claims downgraded to INFERENCE.

nodes.label: Syncthing transports AURIX understands
nodes.rationale: Sync semantics and merging live in AURIX; transport moves opaque immutable files; live SQLite db files are never synchronized.

nodes.label: Per-domain freshness policy
nodes.rationale: Freshness is separate from truth and confidence; per-domain fresh and aging thresholds classify FRESH AGING STALE UNKNOWN; old FACTs stay FACT.

nodes.label: Reuse decision
nodes.rationale: Deterministic REUSE REFRESH RESEARCH CONFLICT INSUFFICIENT ordering where CONFLICT beats REFRESH beats REUSE; LLM may explain but cannot override evidence.

nodes.label: Risk veto authority
nodes.rationale: Strategy versus allocation versus risk are separate; risk always wins; UNKNOWN never becomes ALLOW; NO_TRADE is success.

nodes.rationale: Commits require VALIDATED proposals with private applyOps so agents cannot write graph directly and LLM cannot become system-of-record.

nodes.label: Deterministic Merge conflict-preserving
nodes.rationale: Replay-only idempotent merge with preserved conflicts avoids timestamp-wins and keeps historical evidence intact across devices.

nodes.label: Deterministic Memory Reuse with Staleness
nodes.rationale: Pure-function scoring and freshness bands ensure stale is never treated as current and reuse decisions are reproducible.

nodes.label: Memory-first Research Orchestration
nodes.rationale: Always consult memory before agents to deduplicate work and force refresh on staleness, saving LLM and agent cost.

nodes.label: Look-ahead Prevention Point-in-time Backtest
nodes.rationale: Structural reads at index i plus PIT views prevent survivorship and future leakage so simulation stays honest.

nodes.label: Price-basis Default eod2-adjusted
nodes.rationale: Default to split-bonus-adjusted eod2 for training while keeping raw tej-bazaar as audit archive; manifests record adjustment_policy to avoid mixing bases.

nodes.label: Governance Gates OOS Backtest Edge
nodes.rationale: Require OOS edge over baseline plus cost-aware backtest and drawdown cap before VALIDATED promotion; accuracy alone never promotes.

nodes.label: Governed Promotion Gates
nodes.rationale: VALIDATED requires OOS edge, drawdown caps, walk-forward median-Sharpe floor and stress cap; median-Sharpe floor of zero is non-negativity sanity check not profitability evidence; REJECTED is terminal, only FAILED retryable.
